title: Weight decay strategy trade-off between fine-tuning and linear evaluation
description: Using a smaller weight decay during pretraining improves downstream performance on ImageNet-1% when fine-tuning, but leads to a degradation in linear evaluation performance. The paper uses a linearly increasing schedule that favors linear evaluation.
canonical_description: weight decay schedule presents trade-off between fine-tuning and linear evaluation performance

evidence.quote: However, this also leads to a degradation of performance in linear evaluation.
